CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS access_token ( id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, username VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, principals ${BINARY_TYPE} NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, token_hint VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, scope VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, created TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, expires TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, last_used TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE,
CONSTRAINT pk_access_token_id PRIMARY KEY (id), CONSTRAINT uk_access_token_token_hash UNIQUE (token_hash), CONSTRAINT uk_access_token_username_name UNIQUE (username, name) );
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM access_token ORDER BY username, created;
SELECT * FROM access_token WHERE username = #{username} ORDER BY created;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM access_token WHERE username = #{username} AND name = #{name};
